base.description: Pinned baseline: SGLang at the study branch point; NVFP4 MoE on FlashInfer CUTLASS (the tree's auto choice, flashinfer_trtllm, is SM100-only and crashes on SM120); decode CUDA graphs up to bs 32 (the largest gate workload); attention, FP8 KV cache (from the checkpoint) and dense GEMMs on the tree's defaults.

w32a-mem080.description: T-W32a (gemma4nv-b3-w32a): base plus --mem-fraction-static 0.80, so the KV pools (66k full / 53k sliding tokens) hold W32's 32 x 1152 tokens without retraction; see trials/W32-DIAG.md.

w32b-mem076.description: T-W32b (gemma4nv-b3-w32b, variant of T-W32a): base plus --mem-fraction-static 0.76, the smallest probed fraction whose KV pools (52k full / 41.5k sliding tokens) hold W32 without retraction while leaving 5.2 GB for the teacher-forced logprob peak that OOMed 0.80; see trials/W32-DIAG.md.

splits16.description: T2 (W3, run on bs2): Triton decode attention split-KV count 16 (tree default 8). Copied from W3's bs2 deploy so the stacked trial names its parent.

base2.description: Pinned base2 (W5): base plus T-W32b's --mem-fraction-static 0.76, kept on bs3 (W32 x1.49, W8/W1 neutral, fidelity pass). The KV pools hold W32's 32 x 1152 tokens without retraction and leave room for the teacher-forced logprob peak.

base2-splits16.description: T2 stacked on base2 (W5, variant of the bs2 T2 trial): base2 plus Triton decode attention split-KV count 16 (tree default 8).

smallm-gemm.description: T3 (W6 on bs2, gemma4nv-b2-t3): base2 on commit 1fd77e64b0 (base a9871012 + Triton small-M BF16 GEMM) with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_BF16_GEMM=1, routing the decode-M o_proj and dense MLP BF16 linears off cuBLAS's SM80 WMMA fallback. Same definition as W6's bs2 ref.

base2-splits16-smallm.description: T3 stacked on base2-splits16 (W5, bs3): commit 1fd77e64b0 with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_BF16_GEMM=1 on top of base2 plus split-KV 16.

base3.description: Pinned base3 (W5): base2 + split-KV 16 (T2S, kept on W1 TPOT -1.94%) + Triton small-M BF16 GEMM on commit 1fd77e64b0 (T3S, kept on W8 composite 1.0457), both on bs3.

base3-t3b.description: T3b stacked on base3 (W9, gemma4nv-b3-t3b, variant of gemma4nv-b2-t3b): base3 on commit 36aa977541 (base3's 1fd77e64b0 + cherry-picks 826d472504, bbbf5e4d46, ed0aefcd40; python/ tree identical to ed0aefcd40) with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_FP8_WEIGHT_GEMM=1: both o_proj shapes stored as FP8 E4M3 with per-output-channel scales, decode on the Triton small-M kernel, prefill on cuBLAS over the bf16 upcast.

base4.description: Pinned base4 (W9): base3 + T3b's FP8 E4M3 weight-only o_proj (commit 36aa977541, SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_FP8_WEIGHT_GEMM=1), kept on bs3 (gemma4nv-b3-t3b: W8 composite 1.0142, W1 TPOT -4.03%, decode KL 0.025) and adopted on full GSM8K (delta -0.23 pt, paired 95% CI [-0.92, +0.47]) with tool-JSON 100 -> 100.

base4-glue1.description: T4 sub-step A (W9b, gemma4nv-b3-t4): base4 on commit 1d859709ef (36aa977541 + Gemma4 fused decode glue) with SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FUSED_GLUE=1: q/k/v RMSNorm + RoPE + FP8 KV-cache store in one Triton kernel per layer (activations and KV bytes bit-identical to the unfused path).

base4-glue2.description: T4 (W9b, gemma4nv-b3-t4): base4 on commit 1d859709ef with SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FUSED_GLUE=2: sub-step A plus the post-attention norm pair, the router / pre-FF-2 norm pair and the next layer's input norm in the dual-norm epilogue (270 of 392 glue launches per decode step removed; norm sums reordered).

base5.description: Pinned base5 (W9b): base4 + T4 fused decode glue (commit 1d859709ef, SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FUSED_GLUE=2), kept on bs3 (gemma4nv-b3-t4: W8 composite 1.0626, W1 TPOT -7.6%, W32 +3.9%, decode KL 0.021) with full-GSM8K delta +0.08 pt (paired 95% CI [-0.55, +0.71]) and tool-JSON 100 -> 100.
